metadata.description: Agent skills for building and managing with WSO2 products

plugins.name: api-platform
plugins.description: Skills for the WSO2 API Platform — design, assess, and fix OpenAPI specs for AI agent readiness, security, and design quality; then set up, publish, and manage APIs through the WSO2 API Gateway using the ap CLI.

plugins.name: agent-manager
plugins.description: Skill for driving the WSO2 agent-manager lifecycle through the amctl CLI — install, log in, create/deploy agents, watch builds, fetch logs and metrics, and triage runtime issues.

plugins.name: identity-platform
plugins.description: Skill for managing the WSO2 Identity Platform (Asgardeo) through the asg CLI — install and authenticate, manage applications, users, groups, roles, identity providers, API resources, scopes, branding, organizations, and agents, then integrate the Asgardeo SDK into your app.
